summary: The P2 contract freeze at 3442de6 freezes sound, fail-closed quantifier/coverage semantics for all four first provider families in contracts.md and ADR-0007, mirrored by six protocol_revision=2 field-level schemas. Closure is gated on independent Proof Checker recomputation from frozen ProgramProofIR v2 plus verified_true with complete quantifier coverage; incomplete inputs fail closed to unknown. legacy_preview certificates are excluded from live authority, model text cannot write facts, and the Proof Kernel remains shadow until P5.

non_blocking_findings.title: Finite predicate registry is frozen in prose, not as schema enums
non_blocking_findings.evidence: proof-obligation-v2 and evidence-action-v2 use open string fields for predicate_id and fact_kind.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Emit a machine-readable registry and make the Checker reject predicate/fact pairs outside it.

non_blocking_findings.title: Quantifier is not constrained per predicate
non_blocking_findings.evidence: All proof schemas share one six-value quantifier enum.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Enforce the exact per-predicate quantifier in the Checker registry.

non_blocking_findings.title: Predicate value, parameter and coverage domains need executable constraints
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Several schema fields are deliberately generic objects in the contract draft.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Define per-predicate parameter, value and coverage-domain schemas in the implementation.

non_blocking_findings.title: Unknown certificate witness convention is implicit
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The certificate schema requires witness for every status.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Require an empty witness for unknown or make full witness conditional.

non_blocking_findings.title: Canonical provider-family identifiers should be explicit
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Prose uses path/guard and contract/type while schemas use path_guard and contract_type.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Declare the snake_case schema identifiers canonical.

non_blocking_findings.title: Coverage completeness is quantifier-specific
non_blocking_findings.evidence: exists_path requires a complete witness, while universal predicates require complete domain enumeration.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Encode separate completeness checks for existential, universal, must and exact quantifiers.

non_blocking_findings.title: Polarity and terminal-contribution mapping needs one matrix
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Clause role, certificate polarity and checker terminal contribution are separate enums.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Freeze and enforce a single mapping so refutation cannot contribute confirmation.

checks.name: Four provider families frozen with fail-closed coverage
checks.evidence: contracts.md and ADR-0007 freeze six executable predicates and their quantifiers.

checks.name: Independent Checker is required
checks.evidence: The contract rejects content-hash-only validation and provider/model authority.

checks.name: legacy_preview is non-authoritative
checks.evidence: protocol_revision=2 is mandatory for live certificates and compatibility records cannot close clauses.

checks.name: P2 remains shadow until P5
checks.evidence: ADR-0007 and the phase contracts prohibit runtime authority before P5.

checks.name: P2 entry-gate prerequisites
checks.evidence: P1 is complete and the contract-freeze candidate is clean and hash-bound.

limitations: This is a contract-freeze review, not a final soundness review of implementation or corpus results.
No benchmark was executed and Range truth or benchmark answer content was not read.
No P5 runtime cutover or runtime authority is approved.
attestation: I performed a read-only proof-security contract-freeze review of commit 3442de63f98f90c5ba0df8efa707e8cc540ebd87 and tree 14c7937ef5e892c4ab89dfb3c47f37e930fcba30 at maximum reasoning depth. I found the P2 entry contract sound and fail-closed, with zero blocking findings. I did not edit files, read Range truth or benchmark answers, run a benchmark, or approve runtime cutover.
